notes.title: Updates and Polish - Version 0.041
notes.notes:
Lots of polish and a few new features have been added to the build in the last couple of versions! This build is feature complete for the upcoming demo release.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/927313719015374899/1263348157845344296/Screenshot.png?ex=6699e828&is=669896a8&hm=7de29fc1eefa745626ebf78f24a2634586b4abe63045b8b26aa36bfa20f6d70a&[/img]

Bigger changes include shields for some of the defensive units as well as player controlled space lasers! Both new features are intended to make combat more interesting and give the player more control.

Improvements have been made to the market window and to building menus. The "tutorial" has also been improved and expanded. In particular the concept of "connections" has been a focus. 

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the changes or the state of the game as a whole.

notes.title: Playtest Version 0.037
notes.notes:
First public playtest build! 

This build is a "demo" build. The tech tree is limited to the first 2 tiers of upgrades, but otherwise is fully functional. There are still plenty of rough spots game, where the feel or communication is not fully dialed in. 

Comments can be send from the options menu. When you quit an optional feedback form will will be shown. The more feedback the better!
